models.name: multi_user_todo_guests
models.description: Temporary guest accounts for unauthenticated visitors identified by device ID before registration or login. Guests are anonymous users tracked by their device identifier, allowing the system to maintain context for unauthenticated users until they choose to register or log in.

plainFields.name: device_id
plainFields.description: Unique device identifier used to track anonymous guest users. This allows the system to maintain session continuity for unauthenticated visitors identified by their device.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was first created. Records when this device was first seen by the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated. Tracks the last activity or modification time for this guest record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted. Null means the guest account is active. Used for cleanup of stale or converted guest records.

models.name: multi_user_todo_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access, tracking anonymous user sessions.

This table stores session information for unauthenticated visitors (guests) before they register or log in. Each session is linked to a guest via the multi_user_todo_guest_id foreign key. The table tracks connection metadata including IP address, request URL (href), and referrer for analytics and security purposes. Sessions expire based on the expired_at timestamp and are not soft-deleted since they naturally expire.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Associated guest's {@link multi_user_todo_guests.id}. This links the session to the guest who owns it.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client making the request.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Requested URL path for this session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating the previous page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: multi_user_todo_members
models.description: Registered user accounts with email and password authentication credentials for authenticated access. This is the primary actor table representing authenticated members who can create, manage, and delete their own todos. Each member has a profile with display name that can be edited. Account deletion is permanent and cascades to all associated todos.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for login authentication and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Public display name shown in the member's profile and around the application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the member account was last updated.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for maintaining authenticated member sessions with access and refresh token support. Each session records the member's login event including connection metadata (IP address, URL, referrer) and JWT token pair. Sessions are created upon successful login and tracked until expiration. Multiple concurrent sessions per member are supported.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Authenticated member who owns this session. {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for authenticated API requests.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at session creation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current request URL path.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. NOT NULL to enforce mandatory expiration.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for member account recovery and password change flows. Each token has an expiration time and can be marked as used. Managed through authentication processes, not direct user operations. {@link multi_user_todo_members} owns many password reset tokens.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who requested this password reset. {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password reset token for security. Never store plaintext tokens.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for this reset token. Token is invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token was used. Null if not yet used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset was requested.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for member account registration verification. Each record stores a unique verification token sent to the member's email during registration. Tokens have expiration times and are marked as verified when the member confirms their email address through the verification link.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}. This is the member account this verification token belongs to.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token string sent to the member's email. Used as the lookup key during email verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the verification token. Tokens become invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification was completed. Null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token was last updated.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todos
models.description:
Main todo items owned by users with title, description, dates, completion status, and soft-delete support via deleted_at timestamp for trash workflow.

Each todo belongs to exactly one member and captures task management data including optional start/due dates and completion status. The soft-delete pattern enables the trash workflow where users can view deleted todos, restore them, or permanently delete them.

Relationships:
- Owned by {@link multi_user_todo_members} via multi_user_todo_member_id FK for privacy isolation
- Has many {@link multi_user_todo_todo_edit_histories} entries recording all field mutations

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Owner's member ID. References {@link multi_user_todo_members.id} for privacy isolation - each user can only see their own todos.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title - the main task description. Required on creation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo. Can be empty string.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo. Null if not set.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo. Null if not set.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status flag. False by default when todo is created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Null means not deleted. When set, todo is in trash and excluded from normal list.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todo_edit_histories
models.description: Edit history entries recording field-level mutations for todo items. Each entry captures old and new values for title, description, start_date, and due_date when a todo is edited, with a timestamp. History entries are created automatically when todos are edited and cannot be modified or deleted independently by users.

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_todo_id
foreignFields.description: The todo item this edit history entry belongs to. {@link multi_user_todo_todos.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit was made.

plainFields.name: old_title
plainFields.description: Previous title value before this edit. Null if title was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: New title value after this edit. Null if title was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: old_description
plainFields.description: Previous description value before this edit. Null if description was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: New description value after this edit. Null if description was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: old_start_date
plainFields.description: Previous start date value before this edit. Null if start date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: New start date value after this edit. Null if start date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: old_due_date
plainFields.description: Previous due date value before this edit. Null if due date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: New due date value after this edit. Null if due date was not changed in this edit.
